'''Liam Dentiri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Dentiri was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Master Dentiri returned to the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there. Dentiri, an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] at the Temple, presided over the training grounds in the Temple valley. Dentiri worked on Tython training Jedi to lead Republic troops into battle.<ref name="TOR" />

Dentiri wielded a blue [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] in combat. When the Sith Empire [[Assault on Tython|attacked]] Tython in [[3637 BBY]], Dentiri fought alongside the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to defend the Jedi Temple. Dentiri fell to the Imperial attackers defending the steps of the Temple, despite the support of his training droids.<ref name="Assault" />
